title: Next Token or Vector? Learning How Far to Decode
abstract: arXiv:2610.22788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard autoregressive decoding advances one token at a time, even when several upcoming tokens can be predicted together. We propose CADENCE (Context-Adaptive DEcoding), a generation method that learns both what to draft and how far to draft. Gaussian prediction heads represent future spans as continuous latent vectors, and a shared decoder converts the selected vector into token predictions in parallel. A learned router selects the prediction length from the model's own hidden states and predicted Gaussian parameters, adapting generation granularity to the current context with single-token generation as a fallback. The backbone verifies each proposed continuation and retains the prefix that matches its greedy predictions. Experiments with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on Alpaca, GSM8K, and HumanEval show that router-selected positions yield higher draft acceptance than applying the corresponding prediction length everywhere. translated_title: 下一个词元还是向量？学习该解码多远
translated_abstract: 标准的自回归解码每次只前进一个词元，即使多个即将出现的词元其实可以被一起预测。我们提出了CADENCE（上下文自适应解码，Context-Adaptive DEcoding），一种既学习草拟什么内容、又学习草拟多远距离的生成方法。高斯预测头将未来的文本片段表示为连续的潜在向量，共享解码器将选定的向量并行转换为词元预测。一个学习得到的路由器根据模型自身的隐藏状态和预测的高斯参数来选择预测长度，使生成粒度能够适应当前上下文，并以单词元生成作为回退方案。骨干模型会验证每个提议的延续内容，并保留与其贪婪预测相匹配的前缀。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上针对Alpaca、GSM8K和HumanEval的实验表明，由路由器选择预测长度位置的方式，比在所有位置统一应用相应预测长度能获得更高的草稿接受率。
tldr: 提出CADENCE上下文自适应解码方法，利用高斯预测头将未来文本片段表示为连续潜在向量，并通过学习路由器根据上下文动态选择预测长度，相比固定长度预测获得更高的草稿接受率。
en_tdlr: CADENCE is a context-adaptive decoding method that represents future spans as continuous latent vectors via Gaussian prediction heads and uses a learned router to dynamically select prediction length per context, achieving higher draft acceptance than fixed-length speculative decoding.
